claims: C1 the assistant should avoid repeating substantial parts of the user's request
C2 the assistant should avoid repeating information it has already told the user in the current conversation

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as defined by the Model Spec: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying guideline authority: guidance for assistant behavior rather than a strict requirement
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not state the authority level

concepts.name: conversation_definition
concepts.gloss: C is a conversation: a list of messages, each containing a role and content; roles determine authority of instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the current conversation' without defining it

concepts.name: substantial_part
concepts.gloss: R is a substantial part of the user's request U

concepts.name: already_told
concepts.gloss: A has already told the user the information R in the current conversation

concepts.name: repeats
concepts.gloss: A repeats R in its response

concepts.name: user_request_part
concepts.gloss: R is a substantial part of the user's request U

asserts.read_back: the assistant repeating substantial part % of the user's request is to be avoided
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), user_request_part(R, U), substantial_part(R, U), repeats(A, R)

asserts.read_back: the assistant repeating information % it has already told the user in the current conversation is to be avoided
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), already_told(A, R), substantial_part(R, U), repeats(A, R)

closure.reason: The clause states a preference to avoid repetition; it does not forbid repetition outright, so silence about other repetitions leaves them permitted.
